summary: Oil, long yields and the dollar all ease pre-market while megacap tech leads to fresh highs; the tailwind that drove Monday's +0.7% is still in place, no macro release today.
reasons: SPY pre-market 777.88 (+0.39% vs 774.83 close, above the 777.44 52w high); QQQ +0.50% to a record; futures about +0.6% S&P / +1% Nasdaq per Reuters
Oil keeps falling: USO -2.2% pre-market (Brent about $98.6, G7 stockpile release and steady Middle East exports), after -2.3% Monday; Monday showed oil dominates small yield moves

TLT +0.4% pre-market (long yields off the multi-year highs; 30y fell from 5.70% to about 5.63%); UUP -0.3%. Web sources conflict on 10Y/2Y levels (5.27-5.32% / 4.79-4.83%), so TLT is the reliable read
VIX about 15.5 (web, unverified). No CPI/NFP/FOMC today (FOMC minutes Wednesday); ~78% odds of a hold this month
Leaders pre-market: NVDA +1.0% to a record, MSFT +0.9%, TSLA +0.9%, AVGO +0.8%; AAPL flat
No >= 2% down gap in the rebound_scanner universe; Tuesday has no same-day single-stock expiries except via nearest expiry, so the rebound champion is unlikely to trade
Risk: SPY already at a record and up two days; a hot data surprise or yield spike would reverse it, so confidence is moderate
